items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We met in this room... with Gulda to rehearse the concerto with the conductor... he was a very sweet man... And we recorded with the Concertgebouw.

ctx.x: Yeah! I looked at the score, and I thought, “Well, I can do this.” Like, naively. I got the score, and I had just a glorious six months practicing that first piano concerto, and went to Amsterdam with a complete naive, unreverential attitude toward Mozart. I didn’t worship Mozart, but I loved Mozart. We met in this room (another moment I remember) with Gulda to rehearse the concerto with the conductor. I don’t know if you know the name Nikolaus Harnoncourt, but he’s one of the most revered classical composers.…
Can you trace any developments in your m.o. from being immersed in classical music, in your composing...
